description: Final integration and verification: ensure all features work together, both ENABLE_RC and ENABLE_FUZZY_PID can be toggled independently, config.h has all new constants grouped logically, and the sketch compiles in all 4 flag combinations. Run a final compile check and document any RAM/Flash impact.
steps: LineFollowerFin/config.h: verify all new constants are in logical sections (RC section, Fuzzy PID section). Ensure default values are sensible for uKit Explore 2. Add comments in Indonesian.

LineFollowerFin/LineFollowerFin.ino: ensure conditional compilation guards are correct for both features. Verify object construction order and wiring matches existing patterns (status, sensor, gerak, aman, lapTimer refs).
LineFollowerFin/antarmuka.cpp: ensure help text (status command) covers all new commands: 'mode rc', 'rc on/off', 'fuzzy on/off', and button shortcuts.

Compile all 4 combinations:
  1. ENABLE_RC=false, ENABLE_FUZZY_PID=false (baseline)
  2. ENABLE_RC=true, ENABLE_FUZZY_PID=false
  3. ENABLE_RC=false, ENABLE_FUZZY_PID=true
  4. ENABLE_RC=true, ENABLE_FUZZY_PID=true
All must exit 0 with no errors.
Check Flash and RAM usage for each combination. Report delta from baseline.
Update context.json if any patterns or constraints discovered during implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Flash/RAM usage reported for each combination.
No regression in existing functionality (button cycling, serial commands, safety features).
All new serial commands documented in help text.
verification: Run the 4 compile commands sequentially. Capture 'Sketch uses X bytes (Y%) of program storage space. Global variables use Z bytes (W%) of dynamic memory.' for each. Verify no 'does not name a type' or other errors.
findings:
All 4 flag combinations compile successfully. Flash/RAM usage:
1. Baseline (RC=F, Fuzzy=F): 89,620 bytes (35%) Flash, 6,068 bytes (74%) RAM
2. RC=true, Fuzzy=false: 91,410 bytes (35%) Flash, 6,177 bytes (75%) RAM — delta: +1,790 Flash, +109 RAM
3. RC=false, Fuzzy=true: 91,756 bytes (36%) Flash, 6,369 bytes (77%) RAM — delta: +2,136 Flash, +301 RAM
4. RC=true, Fuzzy=true: 93,546 bytes (36%) Flash, 6,478 bytes (79%) RAM — delta: +3,926 Flash, +410 RAM
All well within ATMega2560 limits (253KB Flash, 8KB RAM). Low memory warning appears for configs 2-4 (expected on ATMega2560). Fuzzy PID adds 3 static const float[5][5] rule tables + float math per PID interval. RC adds pulseIn measurement + serial buffer. Both optional and off by default.
